description: This file contains the implementation of DefaultHealthCheckConfig class, which is a configuration class for health checks in the Eclipse Ditto services utility package. It provides methods to create config instances from a Config object and exposes properties related to health check enabling, interval, and persistence configuration.

classes.name: DefaultHealthCheckConfig
classes.description: Immutable class implementing HealthCheckConfig to hold health check related configurations, including basic health check settings and persistence configuration.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a DefaultHealthCheckConfig instance from the provided Config object, utilizing nested configurations for basic health check and persistence settings.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether the health check is enabled, delegating to basicHealthCheckConfig.

methods.name: getInterval
methods.description: Returns the interval duration between health checks, delegated from basicHealthCheckConfig.

methods.name: getPersistenceConfig
methods.description: Returns the persistence configuration associated with the health check.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare based on basicHealthCheckConfig and persistenceConfig.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode to compute hash based on basicHealthCheckConfig and persistenceConfig.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the configuration object.
